info.name: Monoova Notification Management API
info.description:
Operations tagged Notification Management across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: monoova-cc.yml, monoova-payto.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: Monoova Support
 Email: support@monoova.com

variable.description: (Required) Monoova generated Guid to uniquely identify the subscription. </br> This is required when updating a subscription, if not provided then we assume we are trying to create a new subscription.</br>Is a valid Guid when not blank.
